lines.en: Thick tar slides on the ground

lines.zh: 每跳一步都在地上留黑印
lines.en: Every hop leaves a black mark on the ground.
Its body stretches out, then slumps back.

lines.zh: 沥青顺着它的边淌下来

lines.en: It hops, and the ground clings to it.
A black mass rolls over stones and rights itself.

lines.zh: 它把路边的草都压黑了
lines.en: It blackens every blade of grass it crosses.

lines.zh: 它拖出一道长长的黏液
lines.en: It drags a long slick behind it.

lines.zh: 沥青史莱姆静静地待着
沥青史莱姆静静地不动
沥青史莱姆静静地等待

lines.en: It sits half sunk at the edge of the tar pit.
Its surface bulges and sinks again.
Still but for the popping of bubbles.
Tar slime looks at the player
Tar slime spies on the player
Tar slime looks for a target
It lifts a lump of black to look at you.

lines.zh: 沥青海把我身上挖掉一块。
lines.en: They gouged a chunk out of my tar body.
A chunk of my body has been sliced away.

lines.zh: 沥青漏出来，我轻了一截
lines.en: Tar leaks out; I am lighter now.

lines.zh: 你身陷其中，粘稠的沥青史莱姆缓缓蠕动。
lines.en: You're stuck. The tar slime moves slowly around you.

lines.zh: 巨大的沥青史莱姆盯着你，似乎在思考。”
lines.en: The giant tar slime stares at you, considering.

lines.zh: 你被沥青史莱姆包围，视线变得模糊。
lines.en: You're surrounded by tar slimes, your vision blurring.

lines.zh: 沥青史莱姆伸出手臂，试图将你拉入其中。
lines.en: The tar slime reaches out, trying to pull you in.

lines.zh: 小心，它的触手会缠住你！
lines.en: Be careful, its tentacles will ensnare you!

lines.zh: 你尝到了沥青史莱姆的滋味，却无法呼吸。
lines.en: You taste the tar slime, but you can't breathe.

lines.zh: 巨大的沥青史莱姆从洞中缓缓升起。
lines.en: The giant tar slime rises from the洞中洞.

lines.zh: 沥青史莱姆的叫声如同沉闷的呼噜声。
lines.en: The tar slime's call is a muffled snore.

lines.zh: 你被沥青史莱姆的触手缠住，无法动弹。
lines.en: You're held still by the tar slime's tentacles.

lines.zh: 沥青史莱姆的身躯散发出粘稠的液体。
lines.en: The tar slime exudes a sticky substance.

lines.zh: 巨大的沥青史莱姆突然跳向你！
lines.en: The giant tar slime leaps at you!

lines.zh: 你撞上了沥青史莱姆，被它黏住。
lines.en: You collide with a tar slime, sticking to it.

lines.zh: 你和沥青史莱姆碰撞，溅起沥青。
lines.en: You collide with a tar slime, splattering tar.

lines.zh: 你被沥青史莱姆的触手缠住，无法逃脱。
lines.en: You're ensnared by the tar slime's tentacles.

lines.zh: 巨大的沥青史莱姆撞击你，试图将你困住。
lines.en: The giant tar slime collides with you, trying to trap you.

lines.zh: 你撞上了一个小型沥青史莱姆，被它包裹。
lines.en: You collide with a small tar slime, enveloped by it.

lines.zh: 沥青史莱姆从地上弹起，撞击你。
lines.en: The tar slime bounces up and collides with you.

lines.zh: 你和沥青史莱姆碰撞，粘液溅得到处都是。
沥青史莱姆突然跳起，撞击你。
lines.en: The tar slime leaps, colliding with you.

lines.zh: 你和沥青史莱姆碰撞，身体变得黏糊糊的。

lines.en: Your foot sinks into its body.

lines.zh: 沥青顺着你的鞋往上爬

lines.en: It hits you and peels away a strip of cloth.

lines.zh: 你被粘在原地拔不动脚
lines.en: You stick fast and cannot pull your foot free.

lines.zh: 沥青史莱姆发出咕噜声，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: The tar slime makes a rumbly sound, searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 两块沥青史莱姆碰触，发出粘稠的声音。
lines.en: Two tar slimes touch, making a sticky sound.

lines.zh: 沥青史莱姆相互碰撞，似乎在舞蹈。
lines.en: The tar slimes collide, almost in a dance.

lines.zh: 沥青史莱姆相互靠近，发出低沉的声音。
lines.en: The tar slimes approach each other, making low sounds.

lines.zh: 沥青史莱姆发出咕噜声，寻找爱情。
lines.en: The tar slime makes a rumbly sound, seeking love.

lines.zh: 两块沥青史莱姆碰触，似乎在交流。
lines.en: Two tar slimes touch, seemingly communicating.

lines.zh: 沥青史莱姆发出低沉的声音，似乎在对话。
lines.en: The tar slime makes low sounds, seeming to talk.

lines.zh: 沥青史莱姆相互碰撞，发出粘稠的声音。
lines.en: The tar slimes collide, making a sticky sound.

lines.zh: 沥青史莱姆相互接近，似乎在寻找伴侣。
lines.en: The tar slimes approach each other, seeking a mate.

lines.zh: 沥青史莱姆发出咕噜声，寻找爱意。
lines.en: The tar slime makes a rumbly sound, seeking affection.

lines.zh: 黏糊糊的身体滴答作响。
黑色的史莱姆，散发着恶臭。
lines.en: Black slime, emitting a foul stench.

lines.zh: 你仿佛被一层黑雾包裹。
你似乎被什么东西拉住。
沥青滴下去，正好盖住你的眼。
lines.en: Tar drips down, right over your eyes.

lines.zh: 我从沥青坑里抬起两只眼。
lines.en: I lift two eyes out of the tar pit.

lines.zh: 阴影中的双眼紧盯着你。
lines.en: Eyes in the shadows stare at you.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，史莱姆开始移动。
黑色的眼睛里露出恶意。
阴影中的史莱姆注视你。
黑色的史莱姆遮挡视线。
史莱姆的攻击开始见效。
lines.en: Slime's attack starts to take effect.

lines.zh: 史莱姆的攻击使你失明。
沥青顺着我的身往下滴。

lines.en: A big bubble breaks on the tar pit.
Black sludge churns up from the pit floor.

lines.zh: 沥青黏住我，我沉得很快。
lines.en: Tar grips me and I sink fast.

lines.zh: 沥青把我裹住，动不了了。
lines.en: The tar wraps around me and I can't move.

lines.zh: 沥青黏住了箭，也黏住了你。
lines.en: The tar grips the arrow, and you too.
Light burns through my layer of slime.

lines.zh: 沥青坑里往下沉，看不见了。
lines.en: Sinking in the tar pit, I cannot see.
